howto.title: How to use WinTools
howto.intro: WinTools lives next to File Explorer. There is nothing to open: you use it while you drag files.
howto.step1.text: Start dragging one or more files or a folder in File Explorer, and keep holding the mouse button.
howto.step2.text: While you hold the files, press the trigger key once.
howto.step3.text: The WinTools wheel opens around the pointer. Move toward a group, then toward the command you want.
howto.step4.text: Let go on the command. WinTools does the work in the background and tells you when it is done. Your original is never changed.
howto.convert.text: Change the format: a photo to PNG or WebP, subtitles to VTT, a document to text.
howto.tools.text: The file itself: its information and SHA-256, and compress, resize, rotate, protect, repair, test.
howto.actions.text: Do something with the file: copy its path or name, rename a batch, add to ZIP.
howto.keys.text: Esc closes the wheel without doing anything. Releasing outside the wheel does nothing either.
howto.only: The wheel shows only what fits the files you drag: an image gets image commands, a PDF gets PDF commands.
features.title: Features
features.intro: Everything WinTools can do now. The wheel shows only what fits the files you drag.
about.title: About WinTools
about.text: A file utility for Windows: drag files, press a key, choose what to do. Everything runs on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
about.safe: Your originals are never changed: every result is a new file, and a name that is taken is never overwritten.
onboard.welcome.text: A quick tour, then two or three choices, and you are ready.
onboard.language.text: Choose the language of WinTools. You can change it later in Settings.
onboard.trigger.text: The key you press while dragging files to open the wheel.
onboard.startup.text: Start WinTools when you sign in, so it is always ready.
onboard.ready.text: Drag a file in File Explorer and press {0}.

settings.animations.hintOff: Short movements when the wheel opens and changes. Animation effects are off in Windows now, so Follow Windows shows none.

reason.UnsupportedOperation: This command does not apply to this file.
reason.DecodeFailed: The image is damaged or incomplete.

reason.WorkerCrashed: The worker stopped unexpectedly. The original is unchanged.
reason.InvalidRequest: The file's path is not supported.
reason.IsAFolder: It is a folder; this command works on files.
reason.ClipboardUnavailable: Another program is using the clipboard. Try again.
reason.OnlineOnly: The file is stored online only. Open it once so Windows downloads it, then try again.
reason.Other: Something went wrong. The original is unchanged.
reasonm.InputTooLarge: The {0} is larger than this command accepts.
reasonm.ContentMismatch: The file is not a {0}, whatever its name says.
reasonm.UnsupportedContent: This kind of {0} is not supported.
reasonm.EncodeFailed: The result could not be written correctly. Nothing was saved.
reasonm.NoFreeOutputName: No free name for the result in that folder.
reasonm.PasswordRequired: The {0} is protected with a password. Remove the protection first.
reasonm.PasswordIncorrect: The password does not open the {0}. Nothing was changed.
reasonm.LimitExceeded: The {0} is beyond what this command handles (for example too many pages).
say.The password contains characters tha: The password contains characters that cannot be used.
say.Some marks are in an order (or a for: Some marks are in an order (or a form) that PDF readers change, so some would not accept the password. Retype them in the other order (for example the vowel mark before the shadda), or type the letter as one character.
say.Some characters would change under U: Some characters would change under Unicode normalization (for example ² becomes 2, or a non-breaking space becomes a space), so some PDF readers would not accept the password. Type them as plain characters.
say.The password is too long (at most 12: The password is too long (at most 127 bytes: fewer characters in some scripts).
say.Emoji joined from several (such as a: Emoji joined from several (such as a family or a profession) cannot be used; use single emoji.
say.The name would be too long: The name would be too long
say.The name would hold a character Wind: The name would hold a character Windows does not allow (< > : " / \ | ? *)
say.The name would end with a dot or a s: The name would end with a dot or a space
say.The name is reserved by Windows: The name is reserved by Windows
say.Another file would get the same name: Another file would get the same name
say.A password cannot contain a line bre: A password cannot contain a line break.
say.A password cannot contain control ch: A password cannot contain control characters (such as a tab).
say.A password cannot contain invisible: A password cannot contain invisible characters (direction marks, zero-width spaces, separators).
say.A password cannot contain unassigned: A password cannot contain unassigned or private-use characters.
say.A password cannot contain variation: A password cannot contain variation selectors or other characters that readers drop or refuse (such as the one after an emoji like ❤).
dialog.pick.hint: Enter or double-click runs it on the dropped files. Esc cancels.
dialog.password.newHint: WinTools keeps the password nowhere. Without it the PDF cannot be opened, so keep it safe.
dialog.password.oldHint: The password that opens the file. WinTools keeps it nowhere.
rename.newName.tip: Replaces the whole name; leave empty to keep it. With several files, add a number.
rename.title: Title Case
rename.note: Extensions stay as they are. Nothing is ever overwritten: if a name is taken, nothing is renamed.
rename.badNumber: The number must start at 0 or more, with 1 to 6 digits.
rename.heading: Rename {0:N0} files
reason.rename.NoFreeOutputName: A new name is already used by another file in the folder. Nothing was renamed.
reason.rename.OutputNameInvalid: A new name is not allowed on Windows, or two files would get the same name. Nothing was renamed.
reason.rename.SourceNotReadable: A file is open in another program or cannot be changed. Every name was put back.
reason.rename.SourceNotFound: A file is no longer there. Nothing was renamed.
reason.rename.OutputValidationFailed: The renamed files could not be checked afterwards. Look at the folder to see their names.
reason.rename.Incomplete: A file could not be renamed or put back, and keeps a name starting with "wintools-renaming". Rename it back by hand.
